steps.message: How many tasks do I have due next week in Tasks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i task"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i task""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "cmd package resolve-content-provider org.tasks; cmd package query-content-providers --brief | grep -i org.tasks; content query --uri content://org.tasks 2>/dev/null; content query --uri content://org.tasks/tasks 2>/dev/null; content query --uri content://org.tasks.taskprovider/tasks 2>/dev/null"
